MBS_DOCUMENT_DETAIL.source:
PROCEDURE MBS_DOCUMENT_DETAIL (
        p_sdate        IN  DATE,
        p_edate        IN  DATE,
        p_company_code IN  NUMBER,
        p_result       OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    );

END PKG_BIEL_MBS;

-- PACKAGE BODY --
PACKAGE BODY        PKG_BIEL_MBS AS

    PROCEDURE MBS_DOCUMENT_DETAIL (
        p_sdate        IN  DATE,
        p_edate        IN  DATE,
        p_company_code IN  NUMBER,
        p_result       OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
                                        -- @label: MBS Business Logic Initiator
        OPEN p_result FOR
                                      
            SELECT
                DOCUMENT_CODE,                  -- @label: Policy Number | Policy | Document No | Document Code 
                PARTICIPANT_NAME,               -- @label: Client Name | Participant | Customer | Policy Holder
                PROPOSER_NAME,                  -- @label: Contract Initiator | Premium Payer | Information Provider
                OCCUPATION,                     -- @label: Profession | Job Category | Job Nature | Nature of Job
                DOB,                            -- @label: Date of Birth | Birth Date 
                CNIC_NO,                        -- @label: CNIC Number | CNIC | National Identity Card Number | NIC Number | Identity Card No
                SUBMISSION_DATE,                -- @label: Date of Submission | Submission Date | Document Submisiion Date
                ISSUANCE_DATE,                  -- @label: Policy Issuance Date | Policy Issued | Policy Started
                PLAN_NAME,                      -- @label: Plan Name | Policy Plan | Plan Purchased
                PRODUCT_TYPE,                   -- @label: Plan Product | Product Name | Product Type | Product for Policy
                POLICY_STATUS,                  -- @label: Policy Status | Status of Policy | Status Hold
                CONTRIBUTION,                   -- @label: Contributiion | Contributed | Contribution Received
                MODE_OF_PAYMENT,                -- @label: Payment Mode | Payment Mehtod | Paid Type
                DUE_AMOUNT,                     -- @label: Amount Receivable | Payment Due | Payment Awaited
                PARTICIPANT_TYPE,               -- @label: Participant Type | Participant Category | Participant Guardian
                MEDICAL,                        -- @label: Medical 
                NVL(TOPUP,0) TOPUP,             -- @label: Policy Topup | Topup | Amount Added Topup
                BRANCH_NAME,                    -- @label: Branch Name | Region Branch
                REGION,                         -- @label: Region | Policy Region Base 
                CITY_NAME,                      -- @label: Region City Name | Region City
                RESIDENTIAL_STATUS,             -- @label: Residential Staus | Resident
                SOURCE_CHANNEL,                 -- @label: Source Channel | Policy Elevation | Source Get
                gender,                         -- @label: Participant Gender | Participant Sex
                age,                            -- @label: Participant Age
                ADMIN_ALLOCATION_CHARGES,       -- @label: Admin Charges | Allocation Charges
                PRODUCT_NAME,                   -- @label: Product Name | Policy Product Name
                COUNTRY,                        -- @label: Policy Holder Country | Country of Policy Holder
                SOURCE_TYPE_NAME,               -- @label: Plicy Elevated Source
                RECEIVED_AMOUNT,                -- @label: Amount Received in Finance | Finance Amount Received Policy

                /* your remaining query exactly here */

                CASE
                    WHEN ISSUANCE_DATE BETWEEN p_sdate AND p_edate
                    THEN 'Current'
                    ELSE 'Previous'
                END INVEST_STATUS 
                -- @concept: INVEST_STATUS
                -- @derived: true
                -- @logic: Current if ISSUANCE_DATE falls within the requested date range (p_sdate/p_edate), else Previous 

            FROM
            (
                
                   SELECT DOCUMENT_CODE,
       PARTICIPANT_NAME,
       PROPOSER_NAME,
       CATEGORY_ID_FK occupation_class,
       OCCUPATION,
       DOB,
       CNIC_NO,
       SUBMISSION_DATE,
       ISSUANCE_DATE,
       PLAN_NAME,
       PRODUCT_TYPE,
       POLICY_STATUS,
       CONTRIBUTION,
       MODE_OF_PAYMENT,
       DUE_AMOUNT,
       PARTICIPANT_TYPE,
       MEDICAL,
       NVL(TOPUP,0) TOPUP,
       BRANCH_NAME,
       REGION,
       CITY_NAME,
       RESIDENTIAL_STATUS,
       SOURCE_CHANNEL,
       gender,
       age,
      /* allocation_charges,
       admin_charges,*/
       ADMIN_ALLOCATION_CHARGES,
       PRODUCT_NAME,
       COUNTRY,SOURCE_TYPE_NAME,
       RECEIVED_AMOUNT,
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(TD.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT), 0) 
                  FROM EPF_ACC_TRANSACTION TM, EPF_ACC_TRANSACTION_DTL TD
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND TM.TRANSACTION_ID_PK = TD.TRANSACTION_ID_FK
                   AND TM.TRANSACTION_FLAG IN ('R')
                   AND TRUNC(tm.approved_date) BETWEEN p_SDATE AND p_EDATE 
                   AND TM.DOCUMENT_ID_FK = DOCUMENT_ID_PK) RECEIVED_AMOUNT1,
                   
                   EMP_STATUS,ISSUE_DATE,AGENT_CODE,
--LOADING_VALUE_ID,
    
(
SELECT CLM.DECISION_DATE
FROM EPF_CLM_MASTER CLM, EPF_CLM_DETAIL CD
WHERE CLM.CLAIM_ID_PK = CD.CLAIM_ID_FK
AND   CD.DOCUMENT_ID_FK = DOCUMENT_ID_PK
AND   CD.EMPLOYEE_ID_FK=EMPLOYEE_ID_PK
) DECISION_DATE,


(
SELECT CD1.SETUP_DESCRIPTION
FROM EPF_CLM_MASTER CLM, EPF_CLM_DETAIL CD,EPF_GEN_ST_SETUP_CATEGORY_DTL CD1
WHERE CLM.CLAIM_ID_PK = CD.CLAIM_ID_FK
AND CD1.SETUP_DTL_ID_PK = CLM.CLAIM_CAUSE_ID
AND   CD.DOCUMENT_ID_FK(+) = DOCUMENT_ID_PK
AND   CD.EMPLOYEE_ID_FK=EMPLOYEE_ID_PK
) DEATH_REASON,
                                    case
                                    when ISSUANCE_DATE between P_sdate and p_edate then
                                     'Current'
                                    else
                                     'Previous'
                                  end Invest_Status

  FROM (SELECT T1.DOCUMENT_ID_PK,
               T1.DOCUMENT_CODE,
               T2.EMPLOYEE_ID_PK,
               T3.PARTICIPANT_NAME,
               NULL PROPOSER_NAME,
               T6.CATEGORY_ID_FK,
               T6.OCCUPATION_NAME OCCUPATION,
               Q4.INDIVIDUAL_CONTRIBUTION RECEIVED_AMOUNT,
               T2.DOB,
               T2.CNIC_NO,
               TO_DATE(T1.ENTER_DATE) SUBMISSION_DATE,
               T2.UW_APPROVED_DATE ISSUANCE_DATE,
               --t16.approved_date ISSUANCE_DATE,  ---change
               T4.PLAN_NAME,
               T5.SETUP_DESCRIPTION PRODUCT_TYPE,
               (SELECT SETUP_DESCRIPTION
                  FROM EPF_GEN_ST_SETUP_CATEGORY_DTL D
                 WHERE D.SETUP_DTL_ID_PK = T2.EMP_STATUS_ID_FK) POLICY_STATUS,
               T2.CONTRIBUTION,
               (SELECT SETUP_DESCRIPTION
                  FROM EPF_GEN_ST_SETUP_CATEGORY_DTL D
                 WHERE D.SETUP_DTL_ID_PK = T1.MODE_OF_PAYMENT_ID) MODE_OF_PAYMENT,
               T2.DUE_AMOUNT,
               DECODE(T1.PARTICIPANT_TYPE,
                      'I',
                      'INDIVIDUAL',
                      'C',
                      'CORPORATE') PARTICIPANT_TYPE,
               (SELECT R.DOC_CODE
                  FROM EPF_UW_DOC_REQUIREMENT R
                 WHERE R.DOC_CODE = 'M-PE'
                   AND R.DOCUMENT_ID_FK = T1.DOCUMENT_ID_PK) MEDICAL,
               Q1.TOPUP,
               T11.BRANCH_NAME,
               T11.REGION,
               T12.CITY_NAME,
               decode(T3.RESIDENTIAL_STATUS,'R','Resident','N','Non-Resident') RESIDENTIAL_STATUS,
               T1.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE AS SOURCE_CHANNEL,
               decode(t2.gender,'M','Male','F','Female') gender,
               PKG_EPF_CALCULATION.SF_GHS_AGE_CALCULATION(t1.age_rounding,
                                                          to_date(sysdate),
                                                          t2.dob) age,
                                                         CASE WHEN NVL(T15.ALLOCATION_CHARGES,0) = 0 THEN
                                                              T15.ADMIN_CHARGES
                                                              WHEN NVL(T15.ADMIN_CHARGES,0) = 0 THEN
                                                                T15.ALLOCATION_CHARGES
                                                                END ADMIN_ALLOCATION_CHARGES,
                                                           get_mbt_product_name(PD.PLAN_ID_FK,PD.PRODUCT_TYPE_ID_FK)  PRODUCT_NAME,
               
               (SELECT CD.SETUP_DESCRIPTION
   FROM EPF_GEN_ST_SETUP_CATEGORY_DTL CD 
  WHERE CD.SETUP_DTL_ID_PK =T3.RESIDENT_COUNTRY_ID_FK 
) COUNTRY,
nvl(T3.SOURCE_TYPE_NAME,'Head Office') SOURCE_TYPE_NAME,
(SELECT C.SETUP_DESCRIPTION FROM EPF_GEN_ST_SETUP_CATEGORY_DTL C
WHERE C.SETUP_DTL_ID_PK= T2.EMP_STATUS_ID_FK) EMP_STATUS,
TRUNC(T2.ISSUE_DATE) ISSUE_DATE,


(SELECT PB1.V_aGENT_CODE FROM VU_POLICY_AGENT_BRANCH PB1
WHERE PB1.DOCUMENT_ID_PK = T1.DOCUMENT_ID_PK) AGENT_CODE,RT.LOADING_VALUE_ID

               
          FROM EPF_UW_DOCUMENT T1,
               EPF_UW_EMPLOYEES T2,
               EPF_GEN_ST_PARTICIPANT T3,
               EPF_GEN_ST_PLAN T4,
               EPF_GEN_ST_PRODCUT_DTL PD,
               EPF_GEN_ST_SETUP_CATEGORY_DTL T5,
               EPF_GEN_ST_OCCUPATION T6,
               EPF_UW_RATING RT,
               (SELECT T7.DOCUMENT_ID_FK,
                       T8.EMPLOYEE_ID_FK,
                       NVL(SUM(T8.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT),0) TOPUP
                  FROM EPF_ACC_TRANSACTION T7, EPF_ACC_TRANSACTION_DTL T8
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND T7.TRANSACTION_ID_PK = T8.TRANSACTION_ID_FK
                   AND T7.TRANSACTION_FLAG IN ('R', 'RR')
                   AND TRUNC(t7.approved_date) BETWEEN p_SDATE AND p_EDATE
                   AND T8.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID_FK IN (35)
                 GROUP BY T7.DOCUMENT_ID_FK, T8.EMPLOYEE_ID_FK) Q1,
               EPF_UW_AGENCY_BOOKING T9,
               AMMM_AGENT_MASTER@PENTA_FTPROD T10,
               VU_REGION_BRANCH_LOCATION_SORTING@PENTA_FTPROD T11,
               EPF_GEN_ST_CITY T12,
               -- EPF_UW_COMPLEMT_BENEFIT T13,
              -- EPF_GEN_ST_COMPLEMENT_BENEFIT T14,
               epf_uw_emp_category           t15,
               epf_acc_transaction t16,
               (select A.DOCUMENT_ID_PK,A.DOCUMENT_CODE,SUM(A.INDIVIDUAL_CONTRIBUTION) INDIVIDUAL_CONTRIBUTION 
               from BUSINESS_010226 A
               WHERE A.TRANS_DATE BETWEEN p_SDATE AND p_EDATE
               GROUP BY A.DOCUMENT_ID_PK,A.DOCUMENT_CODE
               ) Q4

         WHERE T1.DOCUMENT_ID_PK = T2.DOCUMENT_ID_FK
           AND T1.PARTICIPANT_ID_FK = T3.PARTICIPANT_ID_PK(+)
           AND T1.PLAN_ID_FK = T4.PLAN_ID_PK
           AND T1.PRODUCT_TYPE_ID_FK = T5.SETUP_DTL_ID_PK
           AND PD.PLAN_ID_FK = T4.PLAN_ID_PK(+)
           AND PD.PRODUCT_TYPE_ID_FK = T1.PRODUCT_TYPE_ID_FK(+)
           AND T3.OCCUPATION_ID_FK = T6.OCCUPATION_ID_PK(+)
           AND T1.DOCUMENT_ID_PK = RT.DOCUMENT_ID_FK(+)
           AND T1.PARTICIPANT_TYPE = 'I'
           ----AND T2.EMP_STATUS_ID_FK = 39
           --AND TRUNC(T2.UW_APPROVED_DATE) BETWEEN &SDATE AND &EDATE
          -- AND TRUNC(t16.TRANSACTION_DATE) BETWEEN :SDATE AND :EDATE   ----changes
         --  AND T1.DOCUMENT_CODE = 'MBT102023001786'
           AND T1.COMPANYID_FK = p_COMPANY_CODE    
           AND Q1.DOCUMENT_ID_FK(+) = T1.DOCUMENT_ID_PK
           AND Q1.EMPLOYEE_ID_FK(+) = T2.EMPLOYEE_ID_PK
           AND T9.DOCUMENT_ID_FK = T1.DOCUMENT_ID_PK
           and t16.document_id_fk = t1.document_id_pk ---add
           and Q4.DOCUMENT_CODE(+) = T1.DOCUMENT_CODE
           --AND T1.DOCUMENT_CODE = 'LKP052025000024'
           AND T9.BOOKING_ID_PK =
               (SELECT MAX(BB.BOOKING_ID_PK)
                  FROM EPF_UW_AGENCY_BOOKING BB
                 WHERE BB.DOCUMENT_ID_FK = T1.DOCUMENT_ID_PK)
           AND T9.AGENCY_ID_FK = T10.N_AGENT_NO
           AND T10.V_BRANCH_CODE = T11.BRANCH_CODE(+)
           AND T3.CITY_ID_FK = T12.CITY_ID_PK(+)
           and t1.document_id_pk = t15.document_id_fk(+))
 GROUP BY DOCUMENT_CODE,
          PARTICIPANT_NAME,
          PROPOSER_NAME,
          OCCUPATION,
          DOB,
          CNIC_NO,
          SUBMISSION_DATE,
          ISSUANCE_DATE,
          PLAN_NAME,
          PRODUCT_TYPE,
          POLICY_STATUS,
          CONTRIBUTION,
          MODE_OF_PAYMENT,
          SOURCE_CHANNEL,
          DUE_AMOUNT,
          PARTICIPANT_TYPE,
          MEDICAL,
          TOPUP,
          BRANCH_NAME,
          REGION,
          CITY_NAME,
          RESIDENTIAL_STATUS,
          ADMIN_ALLOCATION_CHARGES,
          PRODUCT_NAME,
          gender,
          age,/*
          allocation_charges,
          admin_charges,*/
          COUNTRY,SOURCE_TYPE_NAME,DOCUMENT_ID_PK,EMP_STATUS,ISSUE_DATE,AGENT_CODE,
--LOADING_VALUE_ID,
EMPLOYEE_ID_PK, CATEGORY_ID_FK, RECEIVED_AMOUNT
          
                 
       

          
       
          

    )

WHERE
1=1
and NVL(RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0) <> 0;
                
            
    END MBS_DOCUMENT_DETAIL;
